decoded.meaning: FWD{ op=WRITE, dst=/sensor/temp, src=/net/downlink/cli/reply-ep, FIELD{subscribers, 0x01}, SUBSCRIBER{/reply-ep}, PATH_REF_REVERSE{/net/downlink/cli/reply-ep} } - the same relayed subscribe when the hop can issue no PAIR for the arrival link (its connection vertex retired under it): the created 0x15 child starts with the hop's NAME run instead, then the request's src as it arrived (RFC-0029 Amendment 1).
decoded.note: NAME-fallback arm of fwd/subscribe-reverse-list-unflagged; the two differ only in the hop's element.
